Tried first when your phone supports it; falls back to CPU automatically.

CountAI runs a quantized SSD-MobileNet object detector fully on your phone — no internet needed. It recognizes 80 everyday COCO classes (person, bottle, chair, car, cup, dog, cat, …). Note: COCO has no “box” class — cardboard boxes are usually detected as “suitcase”, “book” or “refrigerator” depending on shape.

To count your own products, fruits or inventory: train a model (e.g. in Teachable Machine or with YOLO → TFLite), then replace app/src/main/assets/detect.tflite and labels.txt and rebuild. The Detector interface keeps the UI untouched. Full steps are in the README.
